how: Every position in a shipped schema whose `type` was a list admitting at least five of the seven JSON types was collected -- 864 of them, 862 admitting six -- and then typed against live data: each of the 78 tools holding one was run on its own test_examples and every value the position describes was counted. Readings are pooled across the tools of one config file that share a path, because the same upstream field declared in several wrappers is one field. A position with at least 10 observations covering fewer than six types was narrowed to what was observed; every other position was left alone with the reason recorded here.
two_ways_the_first_pass_measured_it_wron: A return_schema describes either the whole reply or only its `data` member, and no config field says which (2065 of 2817 are the inner kind). Walking the whole reply read 24 positions as populated; honouring both conventions read 220.

Paths were slash-joined at first, which cannot address GBIF's properties whose names are URLs ('http://unknown.org/status'). Those five positions were skipped without a word. Paths here are segment lists.
why_null_stays: A single live pass is a lower bound -- LINCS_search_signatures returned pubchem_id as a string in one pass and as 5311 in another, minutes apart (#881). Absence is the likeliest value an example did not happen to show, so `null` is kept in every narrowed declaration even where it was not observed.
why_integer_does_not_replace_number: `{"type": "number"}` already accepts an integer. Replacing a declared `number` with `integer` because this pass saw whole numbers would invent a precision claim the data does not support, and 1.5 would then be a fabricated mismatch. Where `number` was declared and only whole numbers were seen, `number` stays.
invariant: A narrowed position declares exactly what is recorded in declared_after: it may not be widened back to a blanket, and it may not be narrowed below the measurement. A position left wide must still cover every type observed at it. No position anywhere in the corpus may declare five or more of the seven without a row here -- that is what stops the class growing back.
not_a_measurement: This file is a RECORDING of what the tools returned on the date it names, not a claim that the declarations are now complete. Re-measure before trusting it as current. As a guard it stays exact, because more data can only add types.
